question: What is the difference between ICT Enabled Programs, Correspondence and Regular Face to Face instructional formats?
groound_truth: ICT Enabled Programs, Correspondence and regular Face-to-face degrees/programs from accredited Universities offer instructions in the areas where the student has enrolled for. However, in regular face-to-face programs, one has to attend physical classes and follow a time-table. The Correspondence program, on the other hand, provides students with study material to learn at their own convenience but the process comes with limited academic interactivity. Whereas in ICT Enabled Programs, the student gets an opportunity to view videos, take assignments at anytime, anywhere from a device of his convenience. ICT Enabled Programs are best suited to meet the needs of students who prefer flexibility, quality, affordability and high interactivity.

question: What will be the medium of instruction for all programs?
groound_truth: English is the preferred language for all the programs.

question: Are all the Programs for Graduation and Post-Graduation available in the online format?
groound_truth: Not every program is available online. The University has planned to launch several programs in the ICT Enabled Programs format very soon. This shall depend upon the interest of the students for particular programs. You may want to submit your request if the program you desire does not feature in the available list of programs.

question: How do I apply for an ICT Enabled program?
groound_truth: Admissions for the ICT Enabled Programs can be taken using the Online Application Form. Please do check for the current batches. The student needs to align himself/herself with the currently running batches in the University. However, if desired, the student can also download the offline application form, fill it up and send the same to the University (please refer to the ‘Admission’ section of the website).
